model.description: Harbor House presents Bajah Blast, a premium 0.5g cartridge designed for convenient, flavorful vaping. This sleek cartridge delivers smooth, consistent draws with every use, making it perfect for both experienced enthusiasts and newcomers alike. Bajah Blast offers an energetic and uplifting experience that's ideal for social gatherings, creative projects, or daytime enjoyment. The flavor profile bursts with tropical and citrus notes, complemented by sweet undertones that make each puff refreshing and satisfying. Compatible with standard 510 thread batteries, this cartridge provides hassle-free portability and discreet consumption wherever your day takes you. Harbor House is committed to quality and consistency, ensuring every cartridge meets rigorous standards for purity and potency. Whether you're looking to elevate your mood, spark creativity, or simply unwind without feeling sedated, Bajah Blast delivers a well-rounded experience in a compact, user-friendly format. Perfect for on-the-go relief and enjoyment.
